channel.title: travel.state.gov: Travel Advisories
channel.description: As a first step in planning any trip abroad, check the Travel Advisories for your intended destination.

item.title: Iran - Level 4: Do Not Travel
item.description:
Do not travel

to Iran due to the risk of terrorism, unrest, kidnapping, arbitrary arrest of U.S. citizens, and wrongful detention. Read the entire Travel Advisory.

  • Do not travel to Iran for any reason. U.S. citizens in Iran should leave immediately.

item.title: Yemen - Level 4: Do Not Travel
item.description:
Do not travel

in Yemen due to risk of terrorism, unrest, crime, health risks, kidnapping, and landmines.

Do not travel to Yemen for any reason, including the island of Socotra. The U.S. Embassy in Sana’a suspended its operations in February 2015. The U.S. government cannot offer emergency services to U.S. citizens in Yemen due to the safety risks.

item.title: Israel - Level 3: Reconsider Travel
item.description:
Reconsider travel

to Israel due to terrorism and unrest. Some areas have increased risk. Read the entire Travel Advisory.

As of August 26, 2026, family members may join U.S. government employees who work in Israel.

U.S. government employee travel restrictions

item.title: Ukraine - Level 4: Do Not Travel
item.description:
Do not travel

to Ukraine for any reason due to the Russia-Ukraine war.

U.S. embassy operations
  • The Embassy is open and operating in Kyiv; however, Embassy personnel are subject to movement, curfew, and activity restrictions, which may cause delays in provision of consular assistance to U.S. citizens outside of Kyiv.

item.title: Gaza - Level 4: Do Not Travel
item.description:
Do not travel

 to Gaza due to terrorism, unrest, and limited health infrastructure.

Restrictions on U.S. Government Personnel Movement

U.S. government employees are prohibited from traveling to Gaza for any reason due to safety risks. The U.S. government is unable to provide routine or emergency consular services to U.S. citizens in Gaza.

item.title: Vietnam - Level 1: Exercise Normal Precautions
item.description:
Exercise normal precaution

in Vietnam.

  • Vietnam is generally a safe destination for travelers.  Petty crime is common, especially in popular tourist locations. Stay aware of your surroundings.

item.title: Russia - Level 4: Do Not Travel
item.description:
Do not travel

to Russia for any reason due to terrorism, unrest, wrongful detention and other risks.

U.S. citizens in Russia should leave immediately

item.title: French West Indies - Level 1: Exercise Normal Precautions
item.description:
Reissued after periodic review with minor edits.

Exercise normal precautions in the French West Indies, which includes the islands of Guadeloupe, Martinique, French Saint Martin, and Saint Barthélemy.
